<!-- ============================================================
     ERPNext — Purchase Auditing Voucher Print Format
     Compatible with : ERPNext v13 / v14 / v15
     Templating      : Jinja2 (ERPNext standard)
     Layout          : Full table-based (no flex / no grid)
     Theme           : Dark Navy & Cyan
     Doctype         : Purchase Auditing Voucher (custom)
     CSS Prefix      : pav- (isolated from Sales Auditing Voucher)
     ============================================================

     EXPECTED PARENT FIELDS:
       name, posting_date, from_date, to_date, company,
       supplier, supplier_group, supplier_gstin, currency,
       auditor, department, audit_period, status,
       total_purchase_amount, total_debit, total_credit,
       opening_balance, closing_balance, total_payments,
       net_balance, variance, tds_amount, gst_amount,
       prepared_by, verified_by, approved_by,
       audit_findings, audit_remarks, remarks,
       company_gstin, company_pan, company_address, company_logo

     EXPECTED CHILD TABLE FIELDS (purchase_audit_entries):
       posting_date, voucher_type, voucher_no, bill_no,
       supplier, account, expense_head, remarks,
       purchase_amount, tds_amount, net_payable,
       debit, credit, balance
     ============================================================ -->

<style>
/* ── Reset ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
* { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

body, .print-format {
  font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;
  font-size: 12.5px;
  color: #1a2340;
  background: #fff;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

/* ── Wrapper ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.pav-wrap {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 920px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  background: #fff;
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   HEADER
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.pav-header {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0d1b3e 0%, #102a5a 60%, #0e3a6e 100%);
}

.pav-hd-left {
  padding: 30px 36px 26px;
  vertical-align: top;
  width: 52%;
}

.pav-hd-right {
  padding: 30px 36px 26px;
  vertical-align: top;
  text-align: right;
  width: 48%;
}

/* Company */
.pav-co-name {
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #fff;
  letter-spacing: 0.3px;
  margin-bottom: 5px;
}

.pav-co-meta {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.58);
  line-height: 1.8;
}

/* Title */
.pav-eyebrow {
  font-size: 9.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 3.5px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.40);
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.pav-title-line1 {
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 3px;
  color: rgba(0,198,210,0.75);
  margin-bottom: 2px;
}

.pav-title-line2 {
  font-size: 24px;
  font-weight: 900;
  color: #00c6d2;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  line-height: 1.1;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.pav-doc-ref {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.48);
  margin-bottom: 3px;
}

.pav-doc-ref strong {
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 13px;
}

/* Status pill */
.pav-pill {
  display: inline-block;
  margin-top: 7px;
  padding: 3px 14px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 1.2px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.pav-pill-draft   { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.10); color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55); }
.pav-pill-submit  { background: rgba(0,198,210,0.22);   color: #00c6d2; }
.pav-pill-approve { background: rgba(76,200,130,0.22);  color: #4cc882; }
.pav-pill-reject  { background: rgba(224,90,58,0.22);   color: #e05a3a; }
.pav-pill-cancel  { background: rgba(180,180,180,0.22); color: #aab0be; }

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   IDENTITY BAND  (full-width amber/orange tint for purchase)
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.pav-id-band {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  background: #0d1b3e;
  border-top: 3px solid #00c6d2;
}

.pav-id-band td {
  padding: 5px 36px;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 1.8px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.30);
}

.pav-id-band td span {
  color: rgba(0,198,210,0.70);
  margin-left: 6px;
  letter-spacing: 0;
  font-weight: 500;
  text-transform: none;
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   CYAN INFO STRIP
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.pav-strip {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  background: #00c6d2;
}

.pav-strip td {
  padding: 6px 8px;
  font-size: 9.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.3px;
  color: #0d1b3e;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.pav-strip td span {
  font-weight: 500;
  text-transform: none;
  margin-left: 5px;
  letter-spacing: 0;
  color: #091528;
}

.pav-strip-div {
  color: rgba(13,27,62,0.25) !important;
  font-weight: 300 !important;
  font-size: 12px !important;
  padding: 6px 2px !important;
}
/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   AUDIT CONTEXT BAR  (4 cols)
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.pav-ctx {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  border-bottom: 2px solid #edf0f5;
}

.pav-ctx > tbody > tr > td {
  padding: 18px 36px;
  vertical-align: top;
  border-right: 1px solid #edf0f5;
}

.pav-ctx > tbody > tr > td:last-child { border-right: none; }

.pav-ctx-lbl {
  font-size: 9.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 1.2px;
  color: #00c6d2;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
  padding-bottom: 5px;
  border-bottom: 1.5px solid #edf0f5;
}

.pav-ctx-primary {
  font-size: 13.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #0d1b3e;
  margin-bottom: 3px;
}

.pav-ctx-body {
  font-size: 11.5px;
  color: #5a6a8a;
  line-height: 1.65;
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SECTION HEADING BAR
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.pav-sec-tbl {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
}

.pav-sec-tbl > tbody > tr > td {
  padding: 16px 36px 0;
}

.pav-sec-head {
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 1.2px;
  color: #0d1b3e;
  padding: 5px 10px 5px 12px;
  background: #edf0f5;
  border-left: 3px solid #00c6d2;
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   PAYABLES SUMMARY  (opening / purchases / payments / closing)
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.pav-payables-tbl {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
}

.pav-payables-tbl > tbody > tr > td {
  padding: 14px 36px 0;
}

.pav-payables-inner {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  border: 1px solid #edf0f5;
  border-radius: 6px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.pav-payables-inner thead th {
  background: #f0f3f9;
  color: #5a6a8a;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.6px;
  padding: 8px 14px;
  text-align: left;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #edf0f5;
}

.pav-payables-inner thead th.r { text-align: right; }

.pav-payables-inner tbody td {
  padding: 9px 14px;
  font-size: 12.5px;
  color: #2d3a55;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #edf0f5;
  vertical-align: middle;
}

.pav-payables-inner tbody tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }

.pav-payables-inner tbody td.r {
  text-align: right;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  font-weight: 600;
}

/* row highlight types */
.pav-row-open    td { background: #f7f9ff; }
.pav-row-add     td { background: #fff; }
.pav-row-pay     td { background: #f5fff9; }
.pav-row-close   td { background: #0d1b3e; color: #fff !important; font-weight: 700 !important; }
.pav-row-close td.r { color: #00c6d2 !important; font-size: 14px !important; }

.pav-row-indicator {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  margin-right: 8px;
  vertical-align: middle;
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   PURCHASE LEDGER TABLE
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.pav-ledger-tbl {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
}

.pav-ledger-tbl > tbody > tr > td {
  padding: 0 36px;
}

.pav-ledger {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
}

/* thead */
.pav-ledger thead tr.pav-col-head th {
  background: #0d1b3e;
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.7px;
  padding: 9px 9px;
  text-align: left;
  border-right: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.pav-ledger thead tr.pav-col-head th:last-child { border-right: none; }
.pav-ledger thead tr.pav-col-head th.r { text-align: right; }
.pav-ledger thead tr.pav-col-head th.c { text-align: center; }

.pav-ledger thead tr.pav-col-sub th {
  background: #f0f3f9;
  color: #7a8aaa;
  font-size: 9px;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.4px;
  padding: 4px 9px;
  text-align: right;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #edf0f5;
  border-right: 1px solid #edf0f5;
}

.pav-ledger thead tr.pav-col-sub th:last-child { border-right: none; }
.pav-ledger thead tr.pav-col-sub th.l { text-align: left; }

/* tbody */
.pav-ledger tbody tr { border-bottom: 1px solid #edf0f5; }
.pav-ledger tbody tr:nth-child(even) { background: #f7f9fc; }

.pav-ledger tbody td {
  padding: 9px 9px;
  font-size: 11.5px;
  color: #2d3a55;
  vertical-align: middle;
  border-right: 1px solid #edf0f5;
}

.pav-ledger tbody td:last-child { border-right: none; }
.pav-ledger tbody td.r { text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.pav-ledger tbody td.c { text-align: center; }

/* serial no pill */
.pav-sno {
  display: inline-block;
  min-width: 22px; height: 22px;
  line-height: 22px; text-align: center;
  background: #eef1f8; border-radius: 4px;
  font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 700; color: #5a6a8a;
  padding: 0 4px;
}

/* voucher type tags */
.pav-vtype {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 1px 7px;
  border-radius: 3px;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.3px;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.vtype-pi   { background: #e8f4ff; color: #1464a0; }
.vtype-dn   { background: #fff0e8; color: #a04014; }
.vtype-pe   { background: #e8fff4; color: #148040; }
.vtype-jv   { background: #f4e8ff; color: #640080; }
.vtype-grn  { background: #e8fff0; color: #007040; }
.vtype-pr   { background: #fff8e8; color: #806400; }
.vtype-def  { background: #f0f3f9; color: #5a6a8a; }

/* amount colour helpers */
.pav-dr   { color: #1464a0; font-weight: 600; }
.pav-cr   { color: #148040; font-weight: 600; }
.pav-bal  { color: #0d1b3e; font-weight: 700; }
.pav-neg  { color: #e05a3a; font-weight: 700; }
.pav-tds  { color: #806400; font-weight: 600; }

/* empty state */
.pav-empty td {
  text-align: center; padding: 28px !important;
  color: #7a8aaa; font-style: italic; font-size: 12px;
}

/* tfoot */
.pav-ledger tfoot tr.pav-subtotal td {
  padding: 8px 9px;
  font-size: 11.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  background: #f0f3f9;
  border-top: 2px solid #0d1b3e;
  color: #0d1b3e;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.3px;
}

.pav-ledger tfoot tr.pav-subtotal td.r { text-align: right; }

.pav-ledger tfoot tr.pav-grandtotal td {
  padding: 11px 9px;
  font-size: 12.5px;
  font-weight: 800;
  background: #0d1b3e;
  color: #fff;
  border-top: 2px solid #00c6d2;
}

.pav-ledger tfoot tr.pav-grandtotal td.r    { text-align: right; font-size: 13.5px; }
.pav-ledger tfoot tr.pav-grandtotal td.pav-dr-tot  { text-align: right; color: #7dcfff; font-size: 14px; }
.pav-ledger tfoot tr.pav-grandtotal td.pav-cr-tot  { text-align: right; color: #7dffb0; font-size: 14px; }
.pav-ledger tfoot tr.pav-grandtotal td.pav-bal-tot { text-align: right; color: #00c6d2; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 900; }
.pav-ledger tfoot tr.pav-grandtotal td.pav-tds-tot { text-align: right; color: #ffd97d; font-size: 13.5px; }

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SUMMARY CARDS
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.pav-cards-tbl {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
}

.pav-cards-tbl > tbody > tr > td {
  padding: 14px 36px 0;
}

.pav-cards-inner {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
}

.pav-cards-inner > tbody > tr > td {
  width: 16.66%;
  vertical-align: top;
  padding: 0 7px 0 0;
}

.pav-cards-inner > tbody > tr > td:last-child { padding-right: 0; }

.pav-card {
  border: 1px solid #edf0f5;
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  background: #fff;
  border-top: 3px solid #edf0f5;
}

.pav-card-purch  { border-top-color: #00c6d2; }
.pav-card-dr     { border-top-color: #1464a0; }
.pav-card-cr     { border-top-color: #148040; }
.pav-card-tds    { border-top-color: #a06400; }
.pav-card-var    { border-top-color: #e05a3a; }
.pav-card-bal    { border-top-color: #0d1b3e; }

.pav-card-lbl {
  font-size: 9px;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.9px;
  color: #7a8aaa;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
  line-height: 1.3;
}

.pav-card-val {
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: #0d1b3e;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.pav-card-val.v-purch { color: #00c6d2; }
.pav-card-val.v-dr    { color: #1464a0; }
.pav-card-val.v-cr    { color: #148040; }
.pav-card-val.v-tds   { color: #a06400; }
.pav-card-val.v-var   { color: #e05a3a; }

.pav-card-sub {
  font-size: 10px;
  color: #aab0be;
  margin-top: 4px;
  line-height: 1.3;
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   EXPENSE HEAD ANALYSIS TABLE
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.pav-expense-tbl {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
}

.pav-expense-tbl > tbody > tr > td {
  padding: 14px 36px 0;
}

.pav-expense-inner {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  border: 1px solid #edf0f5;
  border-radius: 6px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.pav-expense-inner thead th {
  background: #f0f3f9;
  color: #5a6a8a;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.6px;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  text-align: left;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #edf0f5;
  border-right: 1px solid #edf0f5;
}

.pav-expense-inner thead th:last-child { border-right: none; }
.pav-expense-inner thead th.r { text-align: right; }

.pav-expense-inner tbody td {
  padding: 8px 12px;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #2d3a55;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #edf0f5;
  border-right: 1px solid #edf0f5;
  vertical-align: middle;
}

.pav-expense-inner tbody td:last-child { border-right: none; }
.pav-expense-inner tbody tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }
.pav-expense-inner tbody td.r { text-align: right; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

/* progress bar inside expense table */
.pav-bar-bg {
  background: #edf0f5;
  border-radius: 20px;
  height: 6px;
  width: 100%;
  overflow: hidden;
  margin-top: 4px;
}

.pav-bar-fill {
  height: 6px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  background: #00c6d2;
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   VARIANCE ANALYSIS TABLE
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.pav-var-tbl {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
}

.pav-var-tbl > tbody > tr > td {
  padding: 14px 36px 0;
}

.pav-var-inner {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  border: 1px solid #edf0f5;
  border-radius: 6px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.pav-var-inner thead th {
  background: #f0f3f9;
  color: #5a6a8a;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.6px;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #edf0f5;
  border-right: 1px solid #edf0f5;
  text-align: left;
}

.pav-var-inner thead th:last-child { border-right: none; }
.pav-var-inner thead th.r { text-align: right; }
.pav-var-inner thead th.c { text-align: center; }

.pav-var-inner tbody td {
  padding: 8px 12px;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #2d3a55;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #edf0f5;
  border-right: 1px solid #edf0f5;
}

.pav-var-inner tbody td:last-child { border-right: none; }
.pav-var-inner tbody tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }
.pav-var-inner tbody td.r { text-align: right; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.pav-var-inner tbody td.c { text-align: center; }

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   TWO-COL LOWER  (checklist | findings)
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.pav-lower-tbl {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
}

.pav-lower-tbl > tbody > tr > td {
  padding: 14px 36px 0;
  vertical-align: top;
  width: 50%;
}

.pav-lower-tbl > tbody > tr > td + td {
  border-left: 1px solid #edf0f5;
  padding-left: 24px;
}

.pav-box {
  border: 1px solid #edf0f5;
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: #fafbfd;
  padding: 14px 16px;
  height: 100%;
}

.pav-box-title {
  font-size: 9.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 1.2px;
  color: #00c6d2;
  padding-bottom: 7px;
  border-bottom: 1.5px solid #edf0f5;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.pav-box-body {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #2d3a55;
  line-height: 1.7;
}

/* Checklist */
.pav-chk {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
}

.pav-chk tr td {
  padding: 5px 0;
  font-size: 11.5px;
  border-bottom: 1px dashed #edf0f5;
  color: #2d3a55;
}

.pav-chk tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }
.pav-chk .ck-label { color: #5a6a8a; }
.pav-ok   { color: #148040; font-weight: 700; text-align: right; }
.pav-warn { color: #a06400; font-weight: 700; text-align: right; }
.pav-err  { color: #e05a3a; font-weight: 700; text-align: right; }
.pav-na   { color: #aab0be; font-weight: 500; text-align: right; }

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   CERTIFICATION BOX
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.pav-cert-tbl {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
}

.pav-cert-tbl > tbody > tr > td {
  padding: 14px 36px 0;
}

.pav-cert-box {
  background: #eef1f8;
  border: 1px solid #d4daea;
  border-left: 3px solid #0d1b3e;
  border-radius: 0 6px 6px 0;
  padding: 11px 16px;
}

.pav-cert-text {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: #2d3a55;
  line-height: 1.75;
}

.pav-cert-text strong { color: #0d1b3e; }

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

<!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     WRAPPER
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
<div class="pav-wrap">

<!-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     1. HEADER
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
<table class="pav-header" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0">
  <tbody>
    <tr>

      <!-- Left: Company -->
      <td class="pav-hd-left">
        <div style="position:relative; overflow:hidden; min-height:60px;">
          <!-- decorative circles — real divs, ERPNext safe -->
          <div style="position:absolute; top:-22px; left:-22px; width:110px; height:110px;
                      border-radius:50%; background:rgba(0,198,210,0.08); pointer-events:none;"></div>
          <div style="position:absolute; bottom:-30px; left:60px; width:70px; height:70px;
                      border-radius:50%; background:rgba(0,198,210,0.05); pointer-events:none;"></div>
          <div style="position:relative; z-index:1;">
            {% if doc.get('company_logo') %}
              <img src="{{ doc.company_logo }}" alt="{{ doc.company }}"
                   style="max-height:46px; margin-bottom:10px; display:block;
                          filter:brightness(0) invert(1);">
            {% endif %}
            <div class="pav-co-name">{{ doc.company }}</div>
            <div class="pav-co-meta">
              {% if doc.get('company_address') %}
                {{ doc.company_address | replace('\n','<br>') }}<br>
              {% endif %}
              {% if doc.get('company_gstin') %}GSTIN: {{ doc.company_gstin }}{% endif %}
              {% if doc.get('company_pan') %}  |  PAN: {{ doc.company_pan }}{% endif %}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </td>

      <!-- Right: Title -->
      <td class="pav-hd-right">
        <div class="pav-eyebrow">Internal Document — Accounts Payable</div>
        <div class="pav-title-line1">Purchase Audit</div>
        <div class="pav-title-line2">Voucher</div>
        <div class="pav-doc-ref">
          Voucher No. <strong>#{{ doc.name }}</strong>
        </div>
        <div class="pav-doc-ref" style="margin-top:3px;">
          Date: <strong>{{ frappe.format(doc.posting_date, {'fieldtype':'Date'}) }}</strong>
        </div>
        {%- set sv = doc.get('status') or 'Draft' -%}
        {%- if   sv == 'Submitted'  -%}<span class="pav-pill pav-pill-submit">✓ Submitted</span>
        {%- elif sv == 'Approved'   -%}<span class="pav-pill pav-pill-approve">✓ Approved</span>
        {%- elif sv == 'Rejected'   -%}<span class="pav-pill pav-pill-reject">✗ Rejected</span>
        {%- elif sv == 'Cancelled'  -%}<span class="pav-pill pav-pill-cancel">⊘ Cancelled</span>
        {%- else                    -%}<span class="pav-pill pav-pill-draft">● Draft</span>
        {%- endif -%}
      </td>

    </tr>
  </tbody>
</table>

<!-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     1b. IDENTITY BAND
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
<table class="pav-id-band" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0">
  <tbody>
    <tr>
      <td>
        Purchase Auditing Voucher
        <span>— Accounts Payable Ledger Review — {{ doc.company }}</span>
      </td>
    </tr>
  </tbody>
</table>

<!-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     2. CYAN STRIP
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
<table class="pav-strip" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0">
  <tbody>
    <tr>
      <td>Audit Period
        <span>
          {{ frappe.format(doc.get('from_date') or doc.posting_date, {'fieldtype':'Date'}) }}
           — 
          {{ frappe.format(doc.get('to_date')   or doc.posting_date, {'fieldtype':'Date'}) }}
        </span>
      </td>
      <td class="pav-strip-div">|</td>
      <td>Auditor<span>{{ (doc.get('auditor') or '—') | safe }}</span></td>
      <td class="pav-strip-div">|</td>
      <td>Department<span>{{ doc.get('department') or '—' }}</span></td>
      <td class="pav-strip-div">|</td>
      <td>Currency<span>{{ doc.currency }}</span></td>
      <td class="pav-strip-div">|</td>
      <td>Voucher Date<span>{{ frappe.format(doc.posting_date, {'fieldtype':'Date'}) }}</span></td>

          📋 Purchase Audit
        </span>
      </td>
    </tr>
  </tbody>
</table>

<!-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     3. AUDIT CONTEXT  (Supplier | Scope | Reference | Preview)
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
<table class="pav-ctx" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0">
  <tbody>
    <tr>

      <!-- Supplier / Vendor -->
      <td style="width:28%;">
        <div class="pav-ctx-lbl">Supplier / Vendor</div>
        <div class="pav-ctx-primary">{{ doc.get('supplier') or '—' }}</div>
        <div class="pav-ctx-body">
          {% if doc.get('supplier_group') %}Group: {{ doc.supplier_group }}<br>{% endif %}
          {% if doc.get('supplier_gstin') %}GSTIN: {{ doc.supplier_gstin }}<br>{% endif %}
          {% if doc.get('territory') %}Territory: {{ doc.territory }}<br>{% endif %}
          {% if doc.get('payment_terms') %}Terms: {{ doc.payment_terms }}{% endif %}
        </div>
      </td>

      <!-- Audit Scope -->
      <td style="width:24%;">
        <div class="pav-ctx-lbl">Audit Scope</div>
        <div class="pav-ctx-primary">{{ doc.get('audit_period') or 'Purchase Ledger Audit' }}</div>
        <div class="pav-ctx-body">
          {{ frappe.format(doc.get('from_date') or doc.posting_date, {'fieldtype':'Date'}) }}
           to 
          {{ frappe.format(doc.get('to_date')   or doc.posting_date, {'fieldtype':'Date'}) }}<br>
          {% if doc.get('cost_center') %}Cost Centre: {{ doc.cost_center }}<br>{% endif %}
          {% if doc.get('department')  %}Dept: {{ doc.department }}{% endif %}
        </div>
      </td>

      <!-- Reference -->
      <td style="width:24%;">
        <div class="pav-ctx-lbl">Reference Details</div>
        <div class="pav-ctx-body" style="line-height:1.9;">
          <span class="muted-t">Voucher No:</span> 
          <strong style="color:#0d1b3e;">{{ doc.name }}</strong><br>
          <span class="muted-t">Posting Date:</span> 
          {{ frappe.format(doc.posting_date, {'fieldtype':'Date'}) }}<br>
          {% if doc.get('amended_from') %}
          <span class="muted-t">Amended From:</span> {{ doc.amended_from }}<br>
          {% endif %}
          <span class="muted-t">Doc Status:</span> 
          {%- if doc.docstatus == 0 %}Saved
          {%- elif doc.docstatus == 1 %}Submitted
          {%- elif doc.docstatus == 2 %}Cancelled
          {%- else %}—{%- endif %}
        </div>
      </td>

      <!-- Quick Totals -->
      <td style="width:24%; background:#f7f9fc;">
        <div class="pav-ctx-lbl">Quick Totals</div>
        <table width="100%" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0">
          <tbody>
            <tr>
              <td style="font-size:11px; color:#5a6a8a; padding-bottom:2px;">Total Purchases</td>
            </tr>
            <tr>
              <td style="font-size:15px; font-weight:800; color:#0d1b3e; padding-bottom:8px;">
                {{ frappe.format(doc.get('total_purchase_amount') or 0,
                   {'fieldtype':'Currency','currency':doc.currency}) }}
              </td>
            </tr>
            <tr>
              <td style="font-size:11px; color:#5a6a8a; padding-bottom:2px;">Net Payable</td>
            </tr>
            <tr>
              <td style="font-size:14px; font-weight:700; color:#00c6d2;">
                {{ frappe.format(doc.get('net_balance') or 0,
                   {'fieldtype':'Currency','currency':doc.currency}) }}
              </td>
            </tr>
            {% if doc.get('tds_amount') %}
            <tr>
              <td style="font-size:11px; color:#a06400; margin-top:6px; padding-top:6px;
                         border-top:1px dashed #edf0f5;">
                TDS: <strong>
                  {{ frappe.format(doc.tds_amount,
                     {'fieldtype':'Currency','currency':doc.currency}) }}
                </strong>
              </td>
            </tr>
            {% endif %}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </td>

    </tr>
  </tbody>
</table>

<!-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     4. PAYABLES SUMMARY  (opening → purchases → payments → closing)
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
<table class="pav-sec-tbl" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="margin-top:16px;">
  <tbody><tr><td>
    <div class="pav-sec-head">▶  Supplier Payables Movement</div>
  </td></tr></tbody>
</table>

<table class="pav-payables-tbl" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0">
  <tbody><tr><td>
    <table class="pav-payables-inner" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0">
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th style="width:5%;">●</th>
          <th style="width:38%;">Particulars</th>
          <th class="r" style="width:19%;">Amount ({{ doc.currency }})</th>
          <th class="r" style="width:19%;">Debit (Dr)</th>
          <th class="r" style="width:19%;">Credit (Cr)</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <!-- Opening Balance -->
        <tr class="pav-row-open">
          <td><span style="display:inline-block;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;
                           background:#5a6a8a;"></span></td>
          <td class="fw-7" style="color:#0d1b3e;">Opening Balance (Supplier A/c)</td>
          <td class="r" style="color:#0d1b3e;">
            {{ frappe.format(doc.get('opening_balance') or 0,
               {'fieldtype':'Currency','currency':doc.currency}) }}
          </td>
          <td class="r muted-t">—</td>
          <td class="r muted-t">—</td>
        </tr>
        <!-- Purchases / Invoices during period -->
        <tr class="pav-row-add">
          <td><span style="display:inline-block;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;
                           background:#1464a0;"></span></td>
          <td style="color:#1464a0; font-weight:600;">
            Add: Purchase Invoices (Period)
            <div style="font-size:10.5px; color:#7a8aaa; font-weight:400; margin-top:1px;">
              Gross purchase amount before deductions
            </div>
          </td>
          <td class="r pav-dr">
            {{ frappe.format(doc.get('total_purchase_amount') or 0,
               {'fieldtype':'Currency','currency':doc.currency}) }}
          </td>
          <td class="r pav-dr">
            {{ frappe.format(doc.get('total_debit') or 0,
               {'fieldtype':'Currency','currency':doc.currency}) }}
          </td>
          <td class="r muted-t">—</td>
        </tr>
        <!-- TDS Deducted -->
        {% if doc.get('tds_amount') %}
        <tr>
          <td><span style="display:inline-block;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;
                           background:#a06400;"></span></td>
          <td style="color:#a06400; font-weight:600;">
            Less: TDS / Withholding Tax Deducted
            <div style="font-size:10.5px; color:#7a8aaa; font-weight:400; margin-top:1px;">
              Tax deducted at source — remitted to authority
            </div>
          </td>
          <td class="r pav-tds">
            ({{ frappe.format(doc.tds_amount,
               {'fieldtype':'Currency','currency':doc.currency}) }})
          </td>
          <td class="r muted-t">—</td>
          <td class="r pav-tds">
            {{ frappe.format(doc.tds_amount,
               {'fieldtype':'Currency','currency':doc.currency}) }}
          </td>
        </tr>
        {% endif %}
        <!-- Payments Made -->
        <tr class="pav-row-pay">
          <td><span style="display:inline-block;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;
                           background:#148040;"></span></td>
          <td style="color:#148040; font-weight:600;">
            Less: Payments Made to Supplier
            <div style="font-size:10.5px; color:#7a8aaa; font-weight:400; margin-top:1px;">
              Payments, settlements and credit notes applied
            </div>
          </td>
          <td class="r pav-cr">
            ({{ frappe.format(doc.get('total_payments') or doc.get('total_credit') or 0,
               {'fieldtype':'Currency','currency':doc.currency}) }})
          </td>
          <td class="r muted-t">—</td>
          <td class="r pav-cr">
            {{ frappe.format(doc.get('total_payments') or doc.get('total_credit') or 0,
               {'fieldtype':'Currency','currency':doc.currency}) }}
          </td>
        </tr>
        <!-- Closing / Net Payable -->
        <tr class="pav-row-close">
          <td><span style="display:inline-block;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;
                           background:#00c6d2;"></span></td>
          <td>Closing Balance — Net Payable to Supplier</td>
          <td class="r">
            {{ frappe.format(doc.get('closing_balance') or doc.get('net_balance') or 0,
               {'fieldtype':'Currency','currency':doc.currency}) }}
          </td>
          <td class="r">
            {{ frappe.format(doc.get('total_debit') or 0,
               {'fieldtype':'Currency','currency':doc.currency}) }}
          </td>
          <td class="r">
            {{ frappe.format(doc.get('total_credit') or 0,
               {'fieldtype':'Currency','currency':doc.currency}) }}
          </td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </td></tr></tbody>
</table>

<!-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     5. PURCHASE LEDGER ENTRIES
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
<table class="pav-sec-tbl" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="margin-top:16px;">
  <tbody><tr><td>
    <div class="pav-sec-head">▶  Purchase Ledger Entries</div>
  </td></tr></tbody>
</table>

<table class="pav-ledger-tbl" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="margin-top:0;">
  <tbody><tr><td style="padding-top:0;">

    <table class="pav-ledger" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0">
      <thead>
        <tr class="pav-col-head">
          <th class="c" style="width:34px;">#</th>
          <th style="width:78px;">Date</th>
          <th style="width:75px;">Type</th>
          <th style="width:105px;">Voucher / Ref</th>
          <th style="width:90px;">Bill / Supp. Inv.</th>
          <th>Supplier / Account</th>
          <th>Expense Head</th>
          <th class="r" style="width:88px;">Purch. Amt.</th>
          <th class="r" style="width:72px;">TDS</th>
          <th class="r" style="width:88px;">Debit (Dr)</th>
          <th class="r" style="width:88px;">Credit (Cr)</th>
          <th class="r" style="width:95px;">Balance</th>
        </tr>
        <tr class="pav-col-sub">
          <th colspan="7" class="l" style="font-size:9px; color:#aab0be;">
            {{ doc.currency }} — All amounts in base currency
          </th>
          <th>{{ doc.currency }}</th>
          <th>{{ doc.currency }}</th>
          <th>{{ doc.currency }}</th>
          <th>{{ doc.currency }}</th>
          <th>{{ doc.currency }}</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>

      <tbody>
        {% set ns = namespace(rows=0) %}
        {% if doc.get('purchase_audit_entries') and doc.purchase_audit_entries|length > 0 %}
          {% for e in doc.purchase_audit_entries %}
          {%- set ns.rows = ns.rows + 1 -%}
          {%- set vt = e.get('voucher_type') or 'Other' -%}
          {%- set vtc =
                'vtype-pi'  if vt in ('Purchase Invoice','PI') else
                'vtype-dn'  if vt in ('Debit Note','DN','Purchase Return') else
                'vtype-pe'  if vt in ('Payment Entry','Payment','PE') else
                'vtype-jv'  if vt in ('Journal Entry','JV') else
                'vtype-grn' if vt in ('Purchase Receipt','GRN','Goods Receipt') else
                'vtype-pr'  if vt in ('Purchase Return','PR') else
                'vtype-def' -%}
          {%- set bal = e.get('balance') or 0 -%}
          <tr>
            <td class="c"><span class="pav-sno">{{ loop.index }}</span></td>
            <td style="white-space:nowrap; font-size:11px;">
              {{ frappe.format(e.get('posting_date') or e.get('date') or '',
                 {'fieldtype':'Date'}) }}
            </td>
            <td><span class="pav-vtype {{ vtc }}">{{ vt }}</span></td>
            <td style="font-size:11px; font-weight:600; color:#0d1b3e; white-space:nowrap;">
              {{ e.get('voucher_no') or e.get('reference') or '—' }}
            </td>
            <td style="font-size:11px; color:#5a6a8a;">
              {{ e.get('bill_no') or e.get('supplier_invoice') or '—' }}
            </td>
            <td>
              <div style="font-weight:600; color:#0d1b3e; font-size:12px;">
                {{ e.get('supplier') or e.get('party') or '—' }}
              </div>
              {% if e.get('account') %}
              <div style="font-size:10.5px; color:#7a8aaa;">{{ e.account }}</div>
              {% endif %}
            </td>
            <td style="font-size:11px; color:#5a6a8a;">
              {{ e.get('expense_head') or e.get('cost_center') or '—' }}
            </td>
            <td class="r" style="font-size:12px; color:#0d1b3e; font-weight:600;">
              {% if e.get('purchase_amount') %}
                {{ frappe.format(e.purchase_amount,
                   {'fieldtype':'Currency','currency':doc.currency}) }}
              {% else %}<span class="muted-t">—</span>{% endif %}
            </td>
            <td class="r pav-tds">
              {% if e.get('tds_amount') and e.tds_amount != 0 %}
                {{ frappe.format(e.tds_amount,
                   {'fieldtype':'Currency','currency':doc.currency}) }}
              {% else %}<span class="muted-t">—</span>{% endif %}
            </td>
            <td class="r pav-dr">
              {% if e.get('debit') and e.debit != 0 %}
                {{ frappe.format(e.debit,
                   {'fieldtype':'Currency','currency':doc.currency}) }}
              {% else %}<span class="muted-t">—</span>{% endif %}
            </td>
            <td class="r pav-cr">
              {% if e.get('credit') and e.credit != 0 %}
                {{ frappe.format(e.credit,
                   {'fieldtype':'Currency','currency':doc.currency}) }}
              {% else %}<span class="muted-t">—</span>{% endif %}
            </td>
            <td class="r {% if bal < 0 %}pav-neg{% else %}pav-bal{% endif %}">
              {% if bal < 0 %}
                ({{ frappe.format(bal * -1,
                   {'fieldtype':'Currency','currency':doc.currency}) }})
              {% else %}
                {{ frappe.format(bal,
                   {'fieldtype':'Currency','currency':doc.currency}) }}
              {% endif %}
            </td>
          </tr>
          {% endfor %}
        {% else %}
          <tr class="pav-empty">
            <td colspan="12">No purchase audit entries found for this voucher.</td>
          </tr>
        {% endif %}
      </tbody>

      <tfoot>
        <tr class="pav-subtotal">
          <td colspan="7" class="fw-7">Sub-Total</td>
          <td class="r">
            {{ frappe.format(doc.get('total_purchase_amount') or 0,
               {'fieldtype':'Currency','currency':doc.currency}) }}
          </td>
          <td class="r pav-tds">
            {{ frappe.format(doc.get('tds_amount') or 0,
               {'fieldtype':'Currency','currency':doc.currency}) }}
          </td>
          <td class="r pav-dr">
            {{ frappe.format(doc.get('total_debit') or 0,
               {'fieldtype':'Currency','currency':doc.currency}) }}
          </td>
